message: I'll build a full pit-to-port coal mining digital twin: mine operations, CHPP processing plant, stockyard, rail load-out, port shipping and end-use customer.
summary: Site 'Blackridge Coal Mine' laid out west-to-east along the material flow. Mine Operations (pit) holds the mobile fleet: exploration and blast-hole drill rigs, two mining excavators (overburden + coal), a wheel loader and a haul-truck fleet delivering ROM coal to the plant. The Processing Plant (CHPP) runs a fixed connected chain: primary crusher -> overland conveyor -> vibrating screen -> dense-media-cyclone washing module, with a thickener for dewatering and a closed water circuit (thickener overflow recycled via pump, make-up water tank + valve + pump, tailings line out). Product coal goes to a Stockyard (stacker-reclaimer + stockpiles), which feeds two load-out branches: Rail Load-Out (train load-out bin over a loco + wagon rake) OR Port (shiploader + berthed bulk carrier). A representative power station stands in as the customer/end-use. Pipes are coloured by medium (slurry, recycled water, make-up water, tailings), heroes get tooltips, and every asset carries units + cadence telemetry per ISA-95/ISA-18.2 conventions.

components.label: Exploration Drill Rig
components.brief: Track-mounted core drill: twin crawler tracks, deck, tall lattice mast, rotating drill string (spinY), rotary head, small control cab, rod rack. Params holeDepth (m, 1m), rotarySpeed (rpm, 5s), penetrationRate (m/h, 1m). Mobile - no ports. States drilling(ok)/tramming(ok)/idle(warn)/stuck(down).

components.label: Blast-Hole Drill Rig
components.brief: Heavy rotary blast-hole drill: crawler tracks, machine house, operator cab, A-frame mast, rotating drill pipe (spinY), dust collector, levelling jacks. Params holeDepth (m, 1m), pulldown (kN, 5s), rotarySpeed (rpm, 5s), holesToday (holes, 1h). Mobile - no ports. States drilling/tramming/idle/fault.

components.label: Mining Excavator
components.brief: Hydraulic mining shovel: crawler tracks, slew turret with counterweight, cab with glass, engine house, boom + stick + bucket, hydraulic cylinder, exhaust stack with rising smoke plume (rise). Params bucketPayload (t, 5s), engineLoad (%, 5s), fuelLevel (%, 15m), hydraulicTemp (degC, 30s), engineHours (h, 1h). Mobile - no ports. States digging(ok)/travelling(ok)/idle(warn)/breakdown(down). Used for both overburden removal and coal extraction.

components.label: Wheel Loader
components.brief: Articulated wheel loader: rear + front frames, cab, lift arms, bucket, 4 spinning wheels (spinY), exhaust. Params payload (t, 5s), hydraulicPressure (bar, 5s), fuelLevel (%, 15m). Mobile - no ports. States loading/travelling/idle/down.

components.label: Haul Truck
components.brief: Rigid-frame mining haul truck: chassis, dump body with canopy, coal load, cab deck + cab, radiator grille, 6 spinning wheels (spinY), exhaust with smoke puff (rise). Params payload (t, 5s), speed (km/h, 5s), fuelLevel (%, 15m), tyreTemp (degC, 5m), engineTemp (degC, 30s). Mobile - no ports. States hauling(ok)/loading(ok)/queuing(warn)/down(down).

components.label: Primary Crusher Station
components.brief: Fixed crusher station on a concrete foundation: ROM retaining walls, inverted-cone receival hopper, crusher housing on 4 columns, drive motor, two spinning flywheels (spinY), discharge chute, maintenance platform + ladder, dust duct. Params throughput (t/h, 5s), css gap (mm, manual), motorCurrent (A, 5s), bearingTemp (degC, 30s), vibration (mm/s, 5s). Port conveyor_out (conveyor, out, +X). States crushing(ok)/standby(warn)/blocked(down).

components.label: Overland Conveyor
components.brief: Catalog type ConveyorBelt - station 8 conveyor transport between crusher and screen; also drawn automatically by conveyor-port connectors elsewhere.

components.label: Vibrating Screen
components.brief: Inclined double-deck screen: concrete pad, 4 legs, coil springs, vibrating deck (bob) with two vibrator motors (spinY), feed chute, oversize chute, undersize hopper. Params feedRate (t/h, 5s), deckLoad (%, 5s), oversizeRate (%, 5m), bearingTemp (degC, 30s). Ports conveyor_in (-X) / conveyor_out (+X). States screening/standby/tripped.

components.label: CHPP Washing Module (DMC)
components.brief: Dense-media-cyclone coal washing module: concrete foundation, 2-floor steel structure on columns, feed + mixing boxes, DM cyclone (cylinder + cone), drain & rinse screens, magnetite densifier, media sump + pump (spinY motor), rotating magnetic separator drum (spinY), product/reject chutes, access stairs, media piping. Params feedRate (t/h, 5s), yield (%, 5m), productAsh (%, 5m), mediaRD (SG, 5s), cyclonePressure (kPa, 5s), magnetiteLoss (g/t, 1h). Ports feed_in (conveyor,in,-X), product_out (conveyor,out,+X), effluent_out (utility,out,+Z), reject_out (utility,out,+Z), water_in (utility,in,-Z), makeup_in (utility,in,-Z). States washing(ok)/standby(warn)/tripped(down).

components.label: Thickener (Dewatering)
components.brief: High-rate thickener: concrete ring foundation, steel tank wall, liquid surface (bob), overflow launder (torus), centre column, access bridge, drive motor, two rotating rake arms (spinY, slow), feedwell, underflow pump. Params bedLevel (m, 1m), rakeTorque (%, 5s), underflowSolids (%, 5m), overflowClarity (NTU, 5m), flocDose (g/t, 15m). Ports feed_in (utility,in), overflow_out (utility,out), underflow_out (utility,out). States normal(ok)/highTorque(warn)/overload(down).

components.label: Stacker-Reclaimer
components.brief: Rail-mounted bucket-wheel stacker-reclaimer: concrete rail beams, travel bogies, portal, slew deck + tower, 16 m boom with belt, spinning bucket wheel (spinY), counterweight boom, pylon + tie rods, operator cab. Params reclaimRate (t/h, 5s), stackRate (t/h, 5s), boomAngle (deg, 30s), travelPos (m, 5s), slewAngle (deg, 30s). Ports conveyor_in (conveyor,in,-X), rail_out (conveyor,out,+X), ship_out (conveyor,out,+X). States stacking(ok)/reclaiming(ok)/idle(warn)/fault(down).

components.label: Coal Stockpile
components.brief: Static stockpile: main coal cone + two lobes on a dark ground ring; matte near-black coal material. Params stockTonnes (t, 15m), moisture (%, manual). No ports, no animation (nothing moves). States normal(ok)/low(warn)/empty(down).

components.label: Train Load-Out Station
components.brief: Elevated train load-out: concrete footings, 4 steel legs, surge bin, inclined feed gallery, batch weigh hopper + discharge chute (cones), pulsing loading beacon (pulse), control cabin, walkway, rail + ballast strip beneath. Params loadRate (t/h, 5s), binLevel (%, 1m), trainLoadedT (t, 15m), wagonsLoaded (wagons, 15m). Port conveyor_in (conveyor,in,-X). States loading(ok)/standby(warn)/gateFault(down).

components.label: Diesel Locomotive
components.brief: Diesel-electric loco in blue livery: underframe, long hood, cab, nose, fuel tank, two bogies with spinning wheels (spinY), exhaust, pulsing headlight (pulse). Params speed (km/h, 5s), tractiveEffort (kN, 5s), fuelLevel (%, 15m). Mobile - no ports. States hauling/shunting/idle/fault.

components.label: Coal Hopper Wagon
components.brief: Bottom-discharge coal hopper wagon: underframe, hopper body, visible coal heap, two bogies with spinning wheels (spinY), brake wheel. Params grossWeight (t, 5m). Mobile - no ports. Default running/idle/fault states.

components.label: Shiploader
components.brief: Travelling wharf shiploader: concrete wharf rails, 4-leg portal + gantry deck, tower, 18 m boom with belt over the berth, spinning head pulley (spinY), telescopic loading chute (bob), counterweight, backstays, cab. Params loadRate (t/h, 5s), boomLuff (deg, 30s), travelPos (m, 5s), loadedThisShift (t, 15m). Port conveyor_in (conveyor,in,-X). States loading(ok)/repositioning(ok)/idle(warn)/estop(down).

components.label: Bulk Carrier Vessel
components.brief: Berthed bulk carrier: berth water plane, hull + tapered bow, deck with 5 hatch covers, accommodation block, bridge, funnel with rising exhaust plume (rise), foremast. Params cargoLoaded (t, 15m), draft (m, 15m), ballast (%, 15m). Mobile marine - no ports. States berthed/loading/underway/delayed(warn)/emergency(down).

components.label: Power Station (End Use)
components.brief: Representative customer site (structural layer): turbine hall, boiler house, banded chimney with rising smoke (rise), two concrete cooling towers with rising steam plumes (rise), coal bunker. Params generationMW (MW, 5m), coalBurnRate (t/h, 5m), stockDays (days, 1h). No ports. States generating(ok)/reduced(warn)/offline(down).

components.label: Open Pit (Highwall & Benches)
components.brief: Civil/terrain context for the pit: dark earth pit floor slab, three terraced highwall benches with a crest berm, an exposed coal seam band along the lowest bench face (polygonOffset), blasted coal muck piles (dark cones), overburden rubble and a safety berm. Params pitDepth (m, manual), stripRatio (m3/t, manual), coalExposed (t, manual). No ports, static. States active(ok)/restricted-blast(warn)/evacuated(down).

components.label: Waste / Overburden Dump
components.brief: Overburden dump: earth pad ring + three brown dump-lobe cones. Params dumpTonnes (t, 15m), stability (%, manual). No ports, static. States normal/monitoring/slipRisk.

components.label: Haul Road
components.brief: 30 m compacted haul-road strip with windrow berms both sides; place rotated instances pit->crusher and pit->dump. Params dustLevel (%, 15m), gradient (%, manual). No ports, static. States open/dusty/closed.

components.label: Make-Up Water Tank
components.brief: Catalog type Tank - CHPP make-up water storage.

components.label: Water Pump
components.brief: Catalog type Pump - thickener-overflow recycle pump and make-up water pump.

components.label: Isolation Valve
components.brief: Catalog type Valve - make-up water isolation.

components.label: Tailings Header
components.brief: Catalog type PipeSegment - thickener underflow to tailings dam (off-scene).
